meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取主机可用资源快照，辅助运行前判断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常跑吃资源的大任务，想知道本机是否扛得住。
copy.tagline_en: Get a snapshot of your machine's available resources before launching a task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run resource-heavy tasks and want to know whether your machine can handle them.

howto.what: 装上后，进行数据分析、模型训练或并行处理等计算密集任务前，它会先探测 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘等资源，生成含资源数据和并行、内存、GPU 加速建议的 .claude_resources.json。只做静态检测，不做压力测试。
howto.when: 用户要求做资源感知的规划，或任务属于数据分析、模型训练、并行处理等资源敏感场景时，会先做资源检测。

say.text: 帮我分析 50GB 的基因数据，先看看内存够不够？
say.note: 检测后会告诉你要不要用 Dask/Zarr 等外存工具。

say.text: 我要训练一个神经网络，检查一下 GPU 支持哪种后端？
say.note: 会探测可用的 GPU 后端并推荐对应库。

say.text: 并行处理 10,000 个文件，推荐一个合适的并发数？
say.note: 会根据核数等给出建议并行度。

howto.what_en: When compute-intensive work is requested (analysis, training, batch processing), it probes CPU/GPU/memory/disk and writes .claude_resources.json with resource facts and parallel/memory/GPU recommendations. Static only; no stress tests.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for resource-aware planning, or the task falls into resource-sensitive scenarios like data analysis, model training, or parallel processing, it performs resource detection first.

say_en.text: Help me analyze a 50GB genomics dataset. First check if memory is enough.
say_en.note: It will advise whether out-of-core tools like Dask/Zarr are needed.

say_en.text: I want to train a neural network. Check which GPU backend is available.
say_en.note: It detects available GPU backends and suggests matching libraries.

say_en.text: I need to process 10,000 files in parallel. Suggest a suitable concurrency level.
say_en.note: It recommends a worker count based on CPU cores.
